greek: νεφέλη γὰρ ἦν ἐπὶ τῆς σκηνῆς ἡμέρας καὶ πῦρ ἦν ἐπʼ αὐτῆς νυκτὸς ἐναντίον παντὸς Ισραηλ ἐν πάσαις ταῖς ἀναζυγαῖς αὐτῶν.
hint: Cloud by day and fire by night stay over the tent before all Israel on all their journeys.

notes.text: Not in Middle Liddell. LSJ gives it no gloss of its own, "= ἀνάζευξις", citing this verse, so it reads Middle Liddell's ἀνάζευξις, a marching off, return home, in the plural.
Genitives of time: of day, of night-season.
Twice, each with the imperfect's formula.

reading: [[a cloud|a cloud, a bird-net|νεφέλη]] [[for|for, since / as, for otherwise / else, now, why / what, would that|γάρ]], was, and kept on being as a standing and continuing condition and not a momentary one, [[upon|upon, on, in, at, near|ἐπί + genitive]] [[of the covered place|of the covered place / tent, of the camp, of the dwelling-place / house / temple, of the wooden stage, of the stage-effect / unreality, of the tented cover / tilt of a wagon, of the bed-tester, of the entertainment given in tents / banquet|σκηνή]] [[of day|of day, of a state / time of life|ἡμέρα]] and [[fire|fire, the funeral-fire|πῦρ]] was, and kept on being as a standing and continuing condition and not a momentary one, [[upon|upon, on, in, at, near|ἐπί + genitive]] of her [[of night-season|of night-season, of night, of the watches of the night, of the dark of night, of the night of death, of the quarter of night|νύξ]] [[in the presence of|in the presence of / before, opposite / face to face, against|ἐναντίον]] [[of all|of all / the whole, of all, of nothing but, of every, of everyone, of every single, of the whole, of quite, of full, of of all kinds, of the whole / one's all|πᾶς]] of [[name:Ισραηλ]] [[in all|within, inside of, and by means of all / the whole, all, nothing but, every, everyone, every single, the whole, quite, full, of all kinds, the whole / one's all|ἐν; πᾶς]] [[to the marchings off|to the marchings off / returns home|ἀναζυγή]] of them.
